auto-best.reason: Auto Best is a routing mode that picks a model per request; no fixed underlying model. Vendor's own docs describe it as an automatic best-model selector.

auto-coding.reason: AI Stupid Level's docs list auto-coding as a routing mode for code that picks a model per request, alongside auto-tooling and auto-value-coding.

auto-fastest-quality.reason: Auto Fastest Quality is an automatic routing mode that selects the fastest model meeting a quality bar per request; no fixed underlying model.

auto-reasoning.reason: Auto Reasoning routes each prompt to the most appropriate reasoning model per request (cf. Arcee's auto-reasoning and similar router offerings); no fixed underlying model.

auto-tooling.reason: AI Stupid Level's docs list auto-tooling as a routing mode for agent sessions that call tools, picking a model per request.

auto-value.reason: Auto Value is an automatic routing mode that balances cost per request; no fixed underlying model.

auto-value-coding.reason: AI Stupid Level's docs list auto-value-coding as a routing mode to spend less per coding run, picking a model per request.

auto-value-reasoning.reason: Auto Value Reasoning is a cost-optimized routing mode that picks a reasoning model per request; no fixed underlying model.

auto-value-tooling.reason: Auto Value Tool Use is a cost-optimized routing mode for tool-using agent sessions, picking a model per request; no fixed underlying model.
